name: Tombstone RIP

features.name: xNudge wilds
features.description: Wilds nudge into view, raising their multiplier with each nudge.

features.name: Free spin modes
features.description: Several bonus modes with escalating multipliers.

review:
The game that pushed max-win hype to the extreme: 300,000x. At its core are xNudge wilds whose multipliers grow every time they nudge, with brutal free spins modes on top.

It's fascinating in demo, but it's one of the most volatile slots ever made, and that cap is a theoretical ceiling, not a realistic target. Play it for the spectacle. Very high volatility, 96.08% RTP.
cons: One of the most volatile slots on the market
